item.title: Manor Oaks School encourages students to believe in themselves with read-aloud assembly
item.description: Manor Oaks School recently welcomed local author Angela O’Hoppe for a meaningful read-aloud assembly. Her children’s book, “If You Choose to Believe Them,” shares the inspiring story of her son, Logan Hoppe of the Los Angeles Angels. The book centers on overcoming doubt, believing in yourself and achieving your dreams with confidence and the support of others.... Read More

item.title: New Hyde Park Memorial High School’s Model UN team wins awards at the Boston Model United Nations Conference
item.description: New Hyde Park Memorial High School’s Model United Nations Club recently participated in the 25th annual Boston University Model United Nations Conference.
